remarks: Versatile Gem: Walkable and with Income Potential - This light-filled Cape Cod offers a rare blend of flexible living and a prime location on one of New Canaan's most coveted streets. Whether you envision a grand 4-bedroom, 3-bath single-family home or a savvy investment using the upstairs 2-bedroom apartment, this home currently features a main-floor primary suite, an additional bedroom and bath, open concept dining and living rooms, a dedicated office, and a striking family room with beams and cathedral ceilings (currently serving as a 3rd bedroom for the sellers). The kitchen flows seamlessly onto a private backyard terrace, while the separate second-floor 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment serves as a legal, $2,000+/month income-producing suite or an ideal in-law residence. Outside, the large and grassy lot acts as a peaceful retreat and a detached two-car garage featuring a workshop and a large loft recreation room. Just steps from the train station, fine dining, and boutique shopping, this property represents an exceptional opportunity to create your dream lifestyle with many living options in a perfect neighborhood setting.
